prompts.stage: Filled wallet design approved by user
prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / logo-brand.
Edit target: the attached current Tadbeer wallet app icon. Create ONE refined FILLED version of this exact wallet identity for user review. Keep its recognizable silhouette: rounded wallet body, two staggered card layers rising diagonally toward the right at the top, and a small gold clasp/compartment on the lower-right front.
MAIN CHANGE: convert the hollow outlined wallet into solid filled shapes. The large lower wallet face must be completely filled with soft mint #73CBB0. The two upper card layers are also filled mint forms, separated by narrow clean dark-navy slits to preserve the stacked wallet structure; avoid large empty outline interiors. Keep the gold #C5B185 clasp in the same lower-right position, with a fine dark-navy separation edge so it is visible against the mint front face. Retain generous rounded corners, balanced geometry, and the proportions of the reference. This is a professional, restrained money-management brand.
BACKGROUND: full-bleed, entirely OPAQUE uniform deep navy #090F18, matching the actual Flutter app canvas. All background pixels should be solid navy, not transparent. Mint and muted gold are the app accents. Keep it flat and clean, no neon tones, gradients, glow, textures, shadows, bevels, 3D, or paper.
COMPOSITION: square 1024x1024 app icon preview, one centered wallet symbol occupying roughly 68 percent of the canvas, plenty of clear space on all sides. No wordmark, no text, no letters, no presentation frame, no device mockup, no extra symbols. Preserve the original wallet brand rather than inventing a different wallet. Output one finished opaque image, not a transparent cutout. Preview only; no application files are being replaced.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the attached filled Tadbeer wallet logo preview.
Change ONLY the BACKGROUND. User finds the current background too black and wants a more colorful background that fits the premium navy, mint and muted gold money-management app style.
Replace the nearly black background with a visibly lighter, rich navy-BLUE to deep TEAL smooth gradient: upper-left #28596B, central #234962, lower-right #1C3154. Make the blue and teal color clearly visible across the entire canvas, including corners; no black or almost-black areas, no heavy dark vignette. Restrained sophisticated depth, entirely smooth, without patterns, noise, texture, objects, text, sparkle or distracting glow.
Preserve the filled mint wallet and gold clasp exactly: same silhouette, dimensions, placement, stacked top layers, mint and gold hues, clean edges, and existing narrow dark separation lines. Do not redraw or redesign the wallet. Preserve generous padding. Square finished app icon preview, 1024x1024, opaque background on the full image, no transparency.
Output just the edited icon. This is a preview only; do not update application assets.

export_note: Final color assets use the approved opaque image directly. Intermediate transparent extraction experiments were discarded and are not referenced by the exporter.
